entities.summary: Charles-Antoine-Guillaume Pigault de l'Espinoy, better known as Pigault-Lebrun, was a French novelist, playwright, and Epicurean. Victor Hugo references Pigault-Lebrun in chapter I part 8 of Les Misérables, describing a senator as "probably a product of Pigault-le Brun."
